title: Doppler Formula Selection
text: The Doppler formula depends on whether the source, observer, or both are moving. For a moving observer approaching a stationary source, use f' = f(v + v_o)/v. For a moving observer receding, use f' = f(v - v_o)/v.

title: Understanding the Physics
text: When you move towards a sound source, you encounter the wavefronts more frequently than if you were stationary. This increases the frequency you perceive. The opposite happens when moving away.
